title: Merv flourishes under Seljuk rule
summary: Merv reached a major phase of development as a capital of the Great Seljuk Empire in the eleventh and twelfth centuries. It occupied an oasis with a much older settlement history.

claims.text: Merv reached a major phase of development as a capital of the Great Seljuk Empire in the eleventh and twelfth centuries. It occupied an oasis with a much older settlement history.
Eleventh–twelfth-century Seljuk phase; not all occupation of the Murgab oasis.

The city places Central Asia within histories of administration and exchange rather than only migration or conquest. Its successive urban centres should not be represented as one settlement unchanged across millennia.
